hook: Compound interest is the force that quietly makes some people rich and keeps others in debt for decades. In this video I explain it from three angles: the numbers (the rule of 72, a penny doubled for 30 days, Franklin's 200-year experiment), the psychology that makes our brains underestimate it, and a simple playbook to make it work for you instead of against you.
